purpose: Track successful lead submissions as GA4 generate_lead events with non-personal parameters.
audience: Marketing and sales teams measuring enquiry conversion quality.

fields.label: Consent
fields.accessibility_notes: Consent field must include explicit wording.

fields.label: Form Source Page
fields.privacy_notes: Use page path or internal label only.

confirmations.name: Lead thank you
confirmations.note: Use only after confirming thank-you page tracking and no sensitive query strings.

feeds.type: Gravity Forms Google Analytics Add-On or GTM handoff

spam_settings.additional_layer: Use approved spam protection before launch.

accessibility_settings.labels: Visible labels are required for all user-facing fields.
accessibility_settings.confirmation: Thank-you page must include clear next steps.

data_retention_notes: Entry stores personal data and consent. Analytics event must exclude personal data and must respect the consent platform where present.

qa_tools: GTM Preview if GTM is in scope

risks: Click-only tracking can count failed submissions.
Consent refusal may correctly suppress analytics events.
